name: Scholomance: Lord Alexei Barov casts Veil of Shadows in combat on Normal (#10061)
contract: Lord Alexei Barov's (10504) 'In Combat - Cast Veil of Shadows' smart_scripts event used event_flags = 16 (SMART_EVENT_FLAG_DIFFICULTY_3). SmartScript::FillScript only keeps a difficulty-flagged event when (1 << (GetSpawnMode()+1)) & event_flags, which for Normal/Heroic/Mythic (spawn modes 0/1/2) tests bits 2/4/8, never bit 16; the event was unreachable on any difficulty Lower Scholomance has, so Veil of Shadows (17820) never cast. The event's own schedule (event_param1=5000, event_param2=12000) is the fix's independent check: once the event is unrestricted again (event_flags = 0), it must be installed and fire within that designed first-cast window after the boss engages; with the regression still present it never fires no matter how long combat runs.

steps.label: CONTROL: the hero is inside Scholomance
CONTROL: the instance runs on Normal difficulty
The hero attacks Barov so combat is established either way
CONTROL: Barov is in combat with the hero
Let Barov's In Combat events run through their first-cast window
Barov casts Veil of Shadows (the event is no longer gated to an unreachable difficulty)
CONTROL: the hero survives the measurement
